title: Psychiatry: reflection and OSCE prompts
description: Mental state examination and risk practice.

questions.q: Write a short mental state examination for a patient I saw (anonymised).
questions.answer: Model: appearance and behaviour, speech, mood and affect, thought form and content, perception, cognition, insight and risk.
Model: build rapport, ask directly and calmly, explore plans, intent, protective factors, escalate to the team.

questions.q: How did I feel during the encounter and how did I look after myself?
questions.answer: Model: honest reflection, support used, action.
